# Awesome FLUX 3 Prompts

60 production-ready FLUX 3 prompts for cinematic video, native audio, multilingual dialogue, advertising, ecommerce, education, travel, sports, architecture, animation, worldbuilding, reference-driven workflows, and API production.

简体中文 · 日本語 · Español · 12 languages

![Prompt count](https://img.shields.io/badge/prompts-60-6c5ce7) ![Languages](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-12-00b894) ![Localized recipes](https://img.shields.io/badge/localized_recipes-33-0984e3) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue) ![Original assets](https://img.shields.io/badge/visuals-original-f39c12) > [!IMPORTANT] > FLUX 3 is rolling out in stages. FLUX 3 Video is available, while FLUX 3 Image and open-weight components have a separate rollout. Confirm current access and parameters on the [official FLUX 3 page](https://bfl.ai/models/flux-3) before building a production workflow. This repository is an independently authored prompt-engineering resource. Every scene concept, prompt, description, title, and preview image in this collection was created for this project. Preview images are **original concept frames**, not official samples, benchmark results, or claims about a specific FLUX 3 generation. Their complete generation prompts are documented in [assets/IMAGE_PROMPTS.md](assets/IMAGE_PROMPTS.md). ## Create with Flaq AI [Flaq AI](https://flaq.ai/about/) is a multi-model AI platform operated by FLAQ AI PTE. LTD. Its team works across product and platform design, model and API engineering, and practical creative workflows—helping developers, creative teams, and businesses move from model discovery to production integration. Run the recipes in this collection through four FLUX 3 workflows: | Start with | Flaq AI API | Use it for | | --- | --- | --- | | A written scene | [FLUX 3 Text to Video](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-text-to-video/) | original scenes, ads, explainers, dialogue, and concept films | | One reference image | [FLUX 3 Image to Video](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-to-video/) | product animation, character motion, and key-visual animation | | An existing clip | [FLUX 3 Video Extend](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-video-extend/) | continuing action, lengthening a scene, and connected storytelling | | A first and last frame | [FLUX 3 Start/End to Video](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-start-end-to-video/) | controlled transitions, product reveals, and endpoint matching | The [complete Flaq AI FLUX 3 API guide](docs/flaq-ai-flux-3-api.md) includes the shared task lifecycle, exact model names and media fields, JavaScript, Python, and cURL examples, polling, errors, security, and production practices. For the fastest start, open the [12-prompt Flaq AI API workflow pack](prompts/flaq-api-workflows.md). It includes three original production recipes for each recommended mode: [Text to Video](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-text-to-video/), [Image to Video](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-to-video/), [Start/End to Video](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-start-end-to-video/), and [Video Extend](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-video-extend/). ## Start from your production need | If you need… | Start here | | --- | --- | | One prompt to customize now | [60-prompt master index](prompts/README.md) | | A prompt filtered by goal or starting asset | [Use-case matrix](docs/use-case-matrix.md) | | Better camera, timing, sound, continuity, or text | [Advanced prompting guide](docs/prompting-guide.md) | | Product ads, ecommerce, or creator UGC | [Advertising](prompts/advertising-ugc.md) · [Ecommerce](prompts/ecommerce-product.md) | | Film, documentary, animation, or an original game | [Cinematic](prompts/cinematic-storytelling.md) · [Documentary](prompts/documentary-nature.md) · [Animation](prompts/animation-design.md) · [Experimental](prompts/social-experimental.md) | | Education, property, transport, travel, or accessibility | [Education](prompts/education-science.md) · [Architecture](prompts/architecture-mobility.md) · [Travel](prompts/travel-hospitality.md) | | Image-to-video, keyframes, or clip continuation | [Reference workflows](prompts/reference-workflows.md) | | API-ready prompts organized by FLUX 3 mode | [Flaq AI API workflows](prompts/flaq-api-workflows.md) | | Turn a prompt into an API request | [Flaq AI FLUX 3 API quickstart](docs/flaq-ai-flux-3-api.md) | | Localized prompts and dialogue tests | [12-language directory](i18n/README.md) | ### What is included - **60 complete recipes**, not one-line fragments: goal, mode, input roles, timeline, camera, physics, audio, continuity, text, and exclusions. - **13 practical packs** spanning creative storytelling, real business workflows, and API-ready production. - **12-language support and 33 localized recipes** with stable shared scene IDs for cross-language speech, instruction, and glyph testing. - **Source-aware production guidance** for reference ownership, final-frame planning, exact copy, honest claims, accessibility, and human review. - **Original concept art and documented image prompts** so preview provenance is clear. | Metric | Included | | --- | ---: | | Distinct canonical prompts | **60** | | Practical prompt packs | **13** | | Supported languages | **12** | | Non-English localized recipes | **33** | | Original concept images | **6** | | Production guides | **3** | ## Why FLUX 3 prompts need a different structure FLUX 3 is a unified multimodal model trained across image, video, and audio. For video, it can work from text, images, reference clips, ordered keyframes, or a previous clip; it can generate optional native audio, multilingual speech, effects, ambience, multiple shots, and typography. A useful prompt therefore describes more than a beautiful frame. | Control layer | What to specify | | --- | --- | | World | Place, time, weather, materials, physical rules, and visual style | | Subject lock | Identity, wardrobe, proportions, hero object, and details that must not drift | | Timeline | Concrete beats with time ranges; one readable action per beat | | Camera | Framing, lens character, movement, focus, and transition logic | | Continuity | Screen direction, light source, geography, prop state, and identity invariants | | Audio | Dialogue language, voice, ambience, Foley, music behavior, and intentional silence | | Typography | Exact text in quotes, language, placement, material behavior, and duration | | Guardrails | What must stay unchanged and the artifacts to avoid | Read the official [FLUX 3 overview](https://bfl.ai/blog/flux-3) for the latest capability and rollout details. ## Prompt library The collection contains **60 original prompts** across thirteen practical packs. The [master index](prompts/README.md) also filters them by input asset, API mode, and business goal. | Pack | Prompts | Best for | | --- | ---: | --- | | [Cinematic storytelling](prompts/cinematic-storytelling.md) | 4 | narrative shorts, multi-shot scenes, comedy, atmospheric filmmaking | | [Advertising & UGC](prompts/advertising-ugc.md) | 4 | product films, social ads, creator content, food campaigns | | [Documentary & nature](prompts/documentary-nature.md) | 4 | observational stories, wildlife, explainers, historical reconstruction | | [Animation & design](prompts/animation-design.md) | 4 | stop-motion, anime, motion graphics, VFX titles | | [Multilingual audio](prompts/multilingual-audio.md) | 4 | dialogue, accents, music performance

# Awesome FLUX 3 Prompts

Una colección de **60 prompts de producción para FLUX 3**: cine, publicidad, ecommerce, educación, viajes, deporte, arquitectura, UGC, documental, animación, audio nativo, diálogo multilingüe, referencias y flujos de API.

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 12 idiomas

> [!IMPORTANT] > FLUX 3 se publica por fases. FLUX 3 Video está disponible; FLUX 3 Image y los componentes de pesos abiertos siguen un calendario distinto. Verifica el acceso actual en la [página oficial](https://bfl.ai/models/flux-3). Las escenas, los textos, los prompts y las imágenes de este repositorio se han creado desde cero. Las imágenes son fotogramas conceptuales originales; no son muestras oficiales ni resultados de benchmark. ## El equipo de Flaq AI y la API de FLUX 3 [Flaq AI](https://flaq.ai/about/) es una plataforma de IA multimodelo operada por FLAQ AI PTE. LTD. Su equipo trabaja en producto y plataforma, ingeniería de modelos y API, y flujos creativos prácticos para ayudar a desarrolladores, equipos creativos y empresas a pasar del descubrimiento a la integración en producción. - [Texto a vídeo](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-text-to-video/) — crea una escena nueva desde una descripción. - [Imagen a vídeo](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-to-video/) — anima producto, personaje, arte o imagen principal. - [Extensión de vídeo](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-video-extend/) — continúa la acción, la cámara, el sonido y la lógica de un clip. - [Fotogramas inicial/final a vídeo](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-start-end-to-video/) — construye una transición controlada entre dos imágenes. La [guía completa de la API FLUX 3 de Flaq AI](docs/flaq-ai-flux-3-api.md) incluye nombres de modelo y campos exactos, ejemplos en JavaScript, Python y cURL, consulta de estado, errores, seguridad de claves y prácticas de producción. La nueva colección de [flujos de API de Flaq AI](prompts/flaq-api-workflows.md) añade 12 prompts originales: tres para texto a vídeo, tres para imagen a vídeo, tres para fotogramas inicial/final y tres para extensión de vídeo. ## Biblioteca | Colección | Prompts | Casos de uso | | --- | ---: | --- | | [Narrativa cinematográfica](prompts/cinematic-storytelling.md) | 4 | historias, varias tomas, plano secuencia | | [Publicidad y UGC](prompts/advertising-ugc.md) | 4 | producto, vídeo vertical, contenido de creador | | [Documental y naturaleza](prompts/documentary-nature.md) | 4 | observación, fauna, explicación | | [Animación y diseño](prompts/animation-design.md) | 4 | stop motion, anime, motion graphics | | [Audio multilingüe](prompts/multilingual-audio.md) | 4 | diálogo, acentos, música, cambio de idioma | | [Flujos con referencias](prompts/reference-workflows.md) | 4 | imagen a vídeo, keyframes, continuación, identidad | | [Ecommerce y producto](prompts/ecommerce-product.md) | 4 | montaje, joyería, skincare, interfaces SaaS | | [Viajes y hospitalidad](prompts/travel-hospitality.md) | 4 | habitaciones, diario local, accesibilidad, gastronomía | | [Deporte y bienestar](prompts/sports-wellness.md) | 4 | seguridad, running, técnica, movimiento adaptado | | [Educación y ciencia](prompts/education-science.md) | 4 | física, salud, pronunciación, museos | | [Arquitectura y movilidad](prompts/architecture-mobility.md) | 4 | inmobiliaria, trenes, carga, logística | | [Social y experimental](prompts/social-experimental.md) | 4 | memes, podcast, juegos originales, croma | | [Flujos de API de Flaq AI](prompts/flaq-api-workflows.md) | 12 | texto, imagen, fotogramas inicial/final y extensión | ## Plantilla recomendada ```text OBJETIVO: [qué debe entender o sentir el público] FORMATO: [relación de aspecto], [duración], [audio sí/no] ENTRADAS: [Imagen 1 = identidad; Imagen 2 = estilo; Clip 1 = movimiento] MUNDO: [lugar, hora, clima, materiales y reglas físicas] BLOQUEO DEL SUJETO: [rostro, ropa, geometría y detalles invariables] CRONOLOGÍA: [por intervalos: plano + cámara + una acción + transición] AUDIO: [idioma, frase exacta entre comillas, ambiente, Foley y música] CONTINUIDAD: [luz, geografía, dirección, ropa y estado de los objetos] TEXTO: mostrar una sola vez: "[copia exacta]". EVITAR: [deriva, sujetos extra, física imposible, texto extra, marca de agua] ``` Ejemplo de diálogo exacto: ```text IDIOMA: español de México. La protagonista dice exactamente: "No llegamos tarde; llegamos cuando empezó la lluvia." Interpretación natural, íntima, sin voz publicitaria. No traducir, parafrasear, repetir, subtitular ni añadir palabras. ``` Consulta [Audio multilingüe](prompts/multilingual-audio.md) y el [conjunto de pruebas en español](i18n/es-ES.md). También están disponibles el [índice de 60 prompts](prompts/README.md), la [matriz de casos de uso](docs/use-case-matrix.md), la [guía avanzada](docs/prompting-guide.md) y la [guía de la API de Flaq AI](docs/flaq-ai-flux-3-api.md). La portada en inglés incluye cinco prompts completos con imágenes conceptuales originales. ## Programa de afiliados de Flaq AI Desarrolladores, creadores, educadores, autores de agentes y analistas de modelos pueden registrarse en el [programa de afiliados de Flaq AI](https://flaq.ai/affiliate-program/), crear un enlace personal de recomendación y obtener comisión por pedidos referidos que cumplan los requisitos. Las condiciones públicas actuales ofrecen un **20 % sobre el primer pedido de pago válido** del usuario referido y un **10 % sobre los pedidos de pago válidos posteriores** realizados dentro de los 60 días siguientes a su registro. El pago final depende de la atribución, reembolsos, contracargos, revisión de riesgo, política vigente y condiciones de colaboración aprobadas. Consulta la [guía para afiliados](docs/flaq-ai-affiliate-program.md) y declara siempre la relación de afiliación. ## Palabras clave prompts FLUX 3, FLUX3 vídeo, generación de vídeo con IA, texto a vídeo, imagen a vídeo, audio nativo, diálogo multilingüe, cine, anuncios, ecommerce, UGC, educación, viajes, inmobiliaria, deporte, keyframes, continuidad de personaje, continuación de vídeo, programa de afiliados Flaq AI

# Awesome FLUX 3 プロンプト集

映画、広告、EC、教育、旅行、スポーツ、建築、UGC、ドキュメンタリー、アニメーション、ネイティブ音声、多言語会話、参照素材、API 制作ワークフロー向けの **60 個の実践的な FLUX 3 プロンプト**です。

English · 简体中文 · Español · 12 languages

> [!IMPORTANT] > FLUX 3 は段階的に公開されています。FLUX 3 Video は利用可能ですが、FLUX 3 Image とオープンウェイトは別の公開スケジュールです。実装前に[公式ページ](https://bfl.ai/models/flux-3)をご確認ください。 本リポジトリのシーン、文章、プロンプト、プレビュー画像はすべて新規制作です。画像は方向性を示すコンセプトフレームであり、公式サンプルやベンチマーク結果ではありません。 ## Flaq AI チームと FLUX 3 API [Flaq AI](https://flaq.ai/about/) は FLAQ AI PTE. # FLUX 3 API Quickstart with Flaq AI

Turn the prompt recipes in this repository into applications, creative tools, batch pipelines, and production experiments through the Flaq AI video API.

> [!NOTE]
> The examples below reflect the live Flaq AI model pages checked on August 28, 2026. Available resolutions, durations, pricing, rate limits, and accepted media constraints may change. Treat each linked model page and the [Flaq AI documentation](https://flaq.ai/docs/?page=api/flux-3) as the source of truth before shipping.

## About the Flaq AI team

[Flaq AI](https://flaq.ai/about/) is a multi-model AI platform operated by **FLAQ AI PTE. LTD.** The team combines three disciplines:

- **Product and platform** — organizing fast-changing image, video, audio, and language models into usable discovery and creation experiences.
- **Model and API engineering** — connecting model access, integration guidance, documentation, and the infrastructure needed to move from evaluation to implementation.
- **Creative workflows** — studying how creators, developers, and businesses use generative models, then turning those patterns into practical production workflows.

For this prompt library, Flaq AI provides a direct path from scene direction to API execution: choose the FLUX 3 mode that matches the available input, submit one asynchronous task, poll its status, and collect the generated video URL.

## Choose the right FLUX 3 endpoint

All four modes use the same task endpoints. The `model_name` and source-media fields determine the workflow.

| Workflow | `model_name` | Required source field(s) | Best for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Text to video](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-text-to-video/) | `flux-3.0-text-to-video` | none | new scenes, concept films, explainers, ads, multilingual dialogue |
| [Image to video](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-to-video/) | `flux-3.0-image-to-video` | `image_url` | animating a product shot, character frame, key visual, or artwork |
| [Video extend](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-video-extend/) | `flux-3.0-video-extend` | `video_url` | continuing action, lengthening a scene, or creating a follow-on beat |
| [Start and end frames to video](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-start-end-to-video/) | `flux-3.0-start-end-to-video` | `image_url`, `image_end_url` | controlled transitions, product reveals, before/after motion, matched endpoints |

## Recommended API by production goal

Flaq AI is the recommended integration path in this repository because the four live FLUX 3 video modes share one authentication style, one asynchronous task endpoint, and one polling response shape. That makes it possible to switch from exploration to reference-controlled production without maintaining a separate client for every mode.

| Production need | Recommended API | Why | Ready-made prompts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Explore an original scene from a brief | [Text to Video](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-text-to-video/) | no source asset required; prompt controls action, camera, sound, dialogue, and world | [F01–F03](../prompts/flaq-api-workflows.md#text-to-video-recommendations) |
| Preserve a product, person, artwork, or first composition | [Image to Video](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-to-video/) | `image_url` anchors visible identity and geometry while the prompt directs motion | [F04–F06](../prompts/flaq-api-workflows.md#image-to-video-recommendations) |
| Land on a designed final frame | [Start/End to Video](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-start-end-to-video/) | separate start and end images provide stronger endpoint control than text alone | [F07–F09](../prompts/flaq-api-workflows.md#startend-frame-recommendations) |
| Continue a source clip's momentum and scene state | [Video Extend](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-video-extend/) | `video_url` carries the existing visual and motion context into the next beat | [F10–F12](../prompts/flaq-api-workflows.md#video-extension-recommendations) |

Start with text-to-video only when no owned source asset must survive. If identity or object geometry matters, prefer image-to-video. If both editorial endpoints matter, supply both frames. If the source already contains the desired motion, exposure, camera path, and ambience, extend it instead of attempting to reconstruct those conditions in a fresh generation.

### Shared endpoints

```text
POST https://api.flaq.ai/api/v1/video/task
GET  https://api.flaq.ai/api/v1/video/{task_id}
```

Authenticate with a server-side API key:

```http
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
Content-Type: application/json
```

Never expose an API key in a browser bundle, public repository, prompt, or client-side mobile application. Route production requests through a trusted backend and load the key from an environment variable or secrets manager.

## One reusable JavaScript client

This Node.js example submits any of the four workflows, validates HTTP responses, handles failed tasks, and applies a polling timeout.

```js
const API_BASE = 'https://api.flaq.ai/api/v1/video';
const API_KEY = process.env.FLAQ_API_KEY;

if (!API_KEY) throw new Error('Set FLAQ_API_KEY before running this script.');

const authHeaders = {
  Authorization: `Bearer ${API_KEY}`,
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
};

async function readJson(response) {
  const payload = await response.json();
  if (!response.ok) {
    const message = payload?.message || payload?.data?.task_status_msg;
    throw new Error(message || `Flaq API returned HTTP ${response.status}`);
  }
  return payload;
}

async function submitVideoTask(input) {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/task`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: authHeaders,
    body: JSON.stringify(input),
  });

  const payload = await readJson(response);
  if (!payload?.data?.task_id) throw new Error('Response did not include data.task_id.');
  return payload.data.task_id;
}

async function waitForVideo(taskId, options = {}) {
  const intervalMs = options.intervalMs ?? 10_000;
  const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 20 * 60_000;
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;

  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/${encodeURIComponent(taskId)}`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${API_KEY}` },
    });
    const payload = await readJson(response);
    const status = payload?.data?.task_status;

    if (status === 'succeed') {
      const videoUrl = payload?.data?.task_result?.videos?.[0]?.url;
      if (!videoUrl) throw new Error('Task succeeded without a video URL.');
      return videoUrl;
    }

    if (status === 'failed') {
      throw new Error(payload?.data?.task_status_msg || 'Video generation failed.');
    }

    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, intervalMs));
  }

  throw new Error(`Timed out while waiting for task ${taskId}.`);
}

async function generateVideo(input) {
  const taskId = await submitVideoTask(input);
  console.log('Task:', taskId);
  return waitForVideo(taskId);
}
```

## Request examples for all four modes

Use one of these request objects with `generateVideo(request)`.

### 1. Text to video

```js
const request = {
  model_name: 'flux-3.0-text-to-video',
  prompt: `A rain-soaked night market seen in one slow tracking shot.
A bicycle courier stops at a noodle stall while steam crosses warm practical light.
Natural motion, stable identity, realistic reflections and native street ambience.`,
  resolution: '1080p',
  aspect_ratio: '16:9',
  duration: 10,
  sound: true,
};

console.log(await generateVideo(request));
```

### 2. Image to video

```js
const request = {
  model_name: 'flux-3.0-image-to-video',
  image_url: 'https://cdn.example.com/product-hero.jpg',
  prompt: `Preserve the exact bottle geometry, label, liquid level, and lighting.
The camera makes a slow 90-degree orbit while a single water droplet travels down the glass.
Keep the product centered and end on a clean, readable hero frame.`,
  resolution: '1080p',
  aspect_ratio: '16:9',
  duration: 10,
  sound: true,
};

console.log(await generateVideo(request));
```

### 3. Video extend

```js
const request = {
  model_name: 'flux-3.0-video-extend',
  video_url: 'https://cdn.example.com/source-scene.mp4',
  prompt: `Continue directly from the source clip's final state.
The subject walks toward the skyline as the camera keeps the same direction, speed, lens character,
lighting, wardrobe, and environmental ambience. Do not reset the action or introduce a new location.`,
  resolution: '1080p',
  aspect_ratio: '16:9',
  duration: 10,
  sound: true,
};

console.log(await generateVideo(request));
```

### 4. Start and end frames to video

```js
const request = {
  model_name: 'flux-3.0-start-end-to-video',
  image_url: 'https://cdn.example.com/start-frame.jpg',
  image_end_url: 'https://cdn.example.com/end-frame.jpg',
  prompt: `Create one physically plausible transition between the supplied frames.
Use a slow forward dolly, preserve the subject's identity and screen position,
match the lighting change gradually, and arrive at the final frame without a last-second morph.`,
  resolution: '720p',
  aspect_ratio: '16:9',
  duration: 8,
  sound: true,
};

console.log(await generateVideo(request));
```

Browse twelve longer, production-oriented request prompts in the [Flaq AI API workflow pack](../prompts/flaq-api-workflows.md).

## Python quickstart

This dependency-light example uses `requests`, preserves the task ID, checks HTTP failures, and stops after a bounded timeout.

```python
import os
import time
import requests

API_BASE = "https://api.flaq.ai/api/v1/video"
API_KEY = os.environ["FLAQ_API_KEY"]
HEADERS = {
    "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}


def submit_video_task(payload):
    response = requests.post(
        f"{API_BASE}/task",
        headers=HEADERS,
        json=payload,
        timeout=60,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    body = response.json()
    task_id = body.get("data", {}).get("task_id")
    if not task_id:
        raise RuntimeError("Response did not include data.task_id")
    return task_id


def wait_for_video(task_id, interval_seconds=10, timeout_seconds=1200):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_seconds
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        response = requests.get(
            f"{API_BASE}/{task_id}",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"},
            timeout=60,
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
        body = response.json()
        data = body.get("data", {})
        status = data.get("task_status")

        if status == "succeed":
            videos = data.get("task_result", {}).get("videos", [])
            if not videos or not videos[0].get("url"):
                raise RuntimeError("Task succeeded without a video URL")
            return videos[0]["url"]
        if status == "failed":
            raise RuntimeError(data.get("task_status_msg") or "Generation failed")

        time.sleep(interval_seconds)

    raise TimeoutError(f"Timed out while waiting for task {task_id}")


payload = {
    "model_name": "flux-3.0-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "A dawn ferry crossing with realistic wake, slow camera drift, and synchronized harbor ambience.",
    "resolution": "1080p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
    "duration": 10,
    "sound": True,
}

task_id = submit_video_task(payload)
print("Task:", task_id)
print("Video:", wait_for_video(task_id))
```

## cURL quickstart

```bash
curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.flaq.ai/api/v1/video/task \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $FLAQ_API_KEY" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
    "model_name": "flux-3.0-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "A quiet cinematic dawn over a working harbor, slow lateral camera move, realistic water and synchronized native ambience.",
    "resolution": "1080p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
    "duration": 10,
    "sound": true
  }'
```

Then poll with the returned `data.task_id`:

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url "https://api.flaq.ai/api/v1/video/YOUR_TASK_ID" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $FLAQ_API_KEY"
```

The terminal states shown by Flaq AI are:

- `succeed` — read `data.task_result.videos[0].url`.
- `failed` — inspect `data.task_status_msg`.
- Any other status — continue polling with a sensible delay.

## Map repository prompts to API fields

The long-form prompts in this repository deliberately separate creative direction from changing API settings.

| Prompt recipe field | API destination |
| --- | --- |
| `WORLD`, `SUBJECT LOCK`, `VISUAL LANGUAGE`, `TIMELINE` | combine into `prompt` |
| `AUDIO`, dialogue, Foley, ambience | keep inside `prompt` and set `sound: true` when supported |
| `AVOID`, continuity constraints, exact text | keep inside `prompt` |
| `FORMAT` aspect ratio | `aspect_ratio` |
| `FORMAT` duration | `duration` |
| desired output size | `resolution` |
| first image or identity frame | `image_url` for image-driven modes |
| target final frame | `image_end_url` for start/end mode |
| source clip to continue | `video_url` for video extend |

## Production checklist

1. **Host inputs on reachable HTTPS URLs.** Confirm that Flaq AI can fetch the asset and that temporary signed URLs will not expire during processing.
2. **Match the mode to the source.** Do not describe an end frame only in text when start/end mode can supply it directly.
3. **Preserve source geometry.** For image-to-video and start/end workflows, explicitly lock identity, product shape, lighting direction, screen position, and details that must not drift.
4. **Continue, do not restart.** A video-extension prompt should describe the next beat and the invariants inherited from the source clip.
5. **Use causal audio direction.** Name visible sound sources, spoken language, exact dialogue, ambience, Foley, and intentional silence.
6. **Design for retries.** Store the task ID, use bounded polling, surface provider error messages, and avoid submitting duplicate paid jobs after a client timeout.
7. **Download and archive deliberately.** Provider URLs may be delivery URLs rather than permanent storage; move approved outputs into your own media pipeline.
8. **Review rights and safety.** Use only authorized source media, likenesses, voices, brands, music, and claims.

| Risk | Test with a minimal prompt first |
| --- | --- |

# FLUX-3-Prompts auf Deutsch (`de-DE`)

Drei vollständig lokalisierte Testszenen. IDs, Timing und Kontinuität bleiben in allen Sprachen gleich.

## I18N-01 — Das Mitarbeitergespräch mit der Büropflanze

```text
FORMAT: 9:16, 15 Sekunden, trockene Komödie, Dialog auf natürlichem Hochdeutsch.

SZENE: Gewöhnlicher kleiner Besprechungsraum am Mittag. Eine müde Angestellte im beigefarbenen Cardigan sitzt einer gesunden Gummibaumpflanze gegenüber. Ein geschlossener Laptop und ein Wasserglas bleiben mittig auf dem Tisch. Starre Smartphone-Kamera.

00:00-00:05 — Sie betrachtet ein leeres Blatt, blickt zur Pflanze und sagt exakt: „Ihr Wachstum in diesem Quartal war außergewöhnlich.“
00:05-00:10 — Unangenehm langer Reaktionsshot der Pflanze. Ein Blatt bewegt sich nur, weil die Klimaanlage anspringt.
00:10-00:15 — Zurück zur Angestellten. Sie schiebt das Glas zur Pflanze und sagt exakt: „Wir erhöhen Ihre Ressourcen.“ Ende mit einem kleinen, ernsten Nicken.

AUDIO: Leises Neonbrummen, entfernter Drucker, natürlicher Dialog, Glas auf Tisch, Klimaanlagen-Klick. Keine Musik und keine Lachspur.
```

# Prompts FLUX 3 en español (`es-ES`)

Tres escenas completamente localizadas. Los ID, el tiempo, la cámara y la continuidad se mantienen para comparar idiomas.

## I18N-01 — Evaluación de la planta de la oficina

```text
FORMATO: 9:16, 15 segundos, comedia impasible, diálogo natural de España.

ESCENA: Una sala de reuniones pequeña y corriente al mediodía. Una empleada cansada, con cárdigan beige, está sentada frente a un ficus sano. Un portátil cerrado y un vaso de agua permanecen en el centro de la mesa. Cámara de móvil fija.

00:00-00:05 — Consulta una hoja en blanco, mira a la planta y dice exactamente: «Tu crecimiento este trimestre ha sido excepcional».
00:05-00:10 — Plano de reacción de la planta incómodamente largo. Una hoja se mueve solo porque arranca el aire acondicionado.
00:10-00:15 — Regreso a la empleada. Desliza el vaso hacia la planta y dice exactamente: «Vamos a aumentar tus recursos». Termina con un pequeño gesto serio de aprobación.

AUDIO: Zumbido de luces, impresora lejana, diálogo natural, vaso sobre la mesa, clic del aire. Sin música ni risas grabadas.

EVITAR: cara en la planta, personas extra, subtítulos, palabras adicionales, objetos que cambien, logotipo, marca de agua.
```

## I18N-02 — Montaje en ocho movimientos

```text
MODO: Imagen a vídeo. La Imagen 1 es la única referencia del producto.
FORMATO: 4:5, 20 segundos, Foley natural.

CONSERVAR: Mesa auxiliar de roble claro, tablero triangular redondeado, tres patas cónicas, tres soportes negros, dos cierres, veta, proporciones y número de piezas.

00:00-00:04 — Cenital. Todas las piezas aparecen una sola vez en disposición despiezada.
00:04-00:12 — Primer plano a tres cuartos. Mostrar ocho movimientos legibles: insertar tres soportes, colocar tres patas y girar dos cierres. No ocultar el contacto con cortes.
00:12-00:17 — Dar la vuelta a la mesa, presionar cada esquina una vez y colocar un vaso lleno para demostrar estabilidad.
00:17-00:20 — Plano de producto estable con espacio libre a la derecha. No generar texto.

AUDIO: Madera, clic metálico, cierres, mesa apoyada y vaso. Sin voz ni música.

EVITAR: automontaje mágico, tornillos extra, manos imposibles, veta cambiante, logotipo, rótulo, marca de agua.
```

## I18N-03 — Cómo absorbe la ciudad la lluvia

```text
FORMATO: 16:9, 20 segundos, maqueta explicativa de arcilla y resina transparente.

00:00-00:06 — Llueve sobre una manzana urbana. El agua azul sigue la cuneta hasta una abertura del bordillo. Texto exacto: «1 · RECOGER».
00:06-00:13 — Sección subterránea. El agua atraviesa tres capas claramente diferenciadas, rotuladas una vez: «ACOLCHADO», «SUELO ARENOSO», «GRAVA».
00:13-00:20 — El agua se infiltra lentamente entre las raíces y la calle deja de inundarse. Texto final exacto: «FRENAR · FILTRAR · INFILTRAR».

NARRACIÓN EXACTA: «Un jardín de lluvia frena la escorrentía, filtra residuos mediante el suelo y las raíces y da tiempo al agua para infiltrarse en el terreno».

AUDIO: Lluvia suave, sonidos de maqueta, narración clara y marimba muy discreta.

EVITAR: agua que sube, tuberías incorrectas, texto diminuto, promesa de eliminar todos los contaminantes, logotipo, marca de agua.
```

# Prompts FLUX 3 en français (`fr-FR`)

Trois scènes de test entièrement localisées. Conserver les identifiants, la chronologie et les contraintes pour comparer les résultats entre langues.

## I18N-01 — L'entretien annuel de la plante

```text
FORMAT : 9:16, 15 secondes, comédie impassible, dialogue en français de France.

SCÈNE : Petite salle de réunion ordinaire à midi. Une employée fatiguée en cardigan beige est assise face à un ficus en bonne santé. Un ordinateur fermé et un verre d'eau restent au centre de la table. Caméra de téléphone fixe.

00:00-00:05 — Elle consulte une feuille blanche, regarde la plante et dit exactement : « Votre croissance ce trimestre est exceptionnelle. »
00:05-00:10 — Long plan de réaction sur la plante. Une feuille bouge uniquement parce que la climatisation démarre.
00:10-00:15 — Retour sur l'employée. Elle fait glisser le verre vers la plante et dit exactement : « Nous allons augmenter vos ressources. » Finir sur un petit signe de tête sérieux.

AUDIO : Néons, imprimante lointaine, dialogue naturel, verre sur la table, déclic de climatisation. Sans musique ni rires enregistrés.

ÉVITER : plante dotée d'un visage, collègues supplémentaires, sous-titres, texte additionnel, accessoires qui changent, logo, filigrane.
```

## I18N-02 — Montage en huit gestes

```text
MODE : Image-vers-vidéo. L'Image 1 est l'unique référence du produit.
FORMAT : 4:5, 20 secondes, bruitages natifs.

PRÉSERVER : Table d'appoint en chêne clair, plateau triangulaire arrondi, trois pieds fuselés, trois supports noirs, deux fixations, veinage, proportions et nombre de pièces.

00:00-00:04 — Vue du dessus. Toutes les pièces sont disposées une seule fois.
00:04-00:12 — Vue rapprochée en trois quarts. Montrer huit gestes lisibles : insérer trois supports, placer trois pieds, tourner deux fixations. Ne masquer aucun contact par une coupe.
00:12-00:17 — Retourner la table, appuyer une fois sur chaque coin, puis poser un verre plein pour montrer sa stabilité.
00:17-00:20 — Plan produit stable avec espace négatif à droite. Aucun texte généré.

AUDIO : Bois, clic métallique, fixations, table posée, verre. Sans voix ni musique.

ÉVITER : auto-assemblage magique, vis supplémentaires, mains impossibles, changement de bois, logo, légende, filigrane.
```

## I18N-03 — Comment la ville absorbe la pluie

```text
FORMAT : 16:9, 20 secondes, maquette explicative en argile et résine.

00:00-00:06 — La pluie tombe sur un pâté de maisons. L'eau bleue suit le caniveau vers l'ouverture du trottoir. Afficher exactement : « 1 · RECUEILLIR ».
00:06-00:13 — Coupe sous le sol. L'eau traverse trois couches clairement distinctes, étiquetées une seule fois : « PAILLIS », « SOL SABLEUX », « GRAVIER ».
00:13-00:20 — L'eau s'infiltre lentement autour des racines; la rue cesse de déborder. Texte final exact : « RALENTIR · FILTRER · INFILTRER ».

NARRATION EXACTE : « Un jardin de pluie ralentit le ruissellement, retient les débris grâce au sol et aux racines, et laisse à l'eau le temps de s'infiltrer. »

AUDIO : Pluie douce, texture de maquette, narration claire, quelques notes discrètes de marimba.

ÉVITER : eau qui monte, canalisations incorrectes, texte minuscule, promesse de dépollution totale, logo, filigrane.
```

## Programme d'affiliation Flaq AI

Les développeurs, créateurs et formateurs peuvent rejoindre le [programme d'affiliation Flaq AI](https://flaq.ai/affiliate-program/), créer un lien de parrainage personnel et recevoir une commission sur les commandes éligibles. Les conditions publiques actuelles prévoient **20 % sur la première commande payante valide** d'un utilisateur parrainé, puis **10 % sur les commandes payantes valides suivantes** effectuées dans les 60 jours après son inscription. Le paiement final dépend de l'attribution, des remboursements, des rétrofacturations, du contrôle des risques et de la politique en vigueur. Consultez le [guide d'affiliation](../docs/flaq-ai-affiliate-program.md) et signalez clairement toute relation d'affiliation.

# Prompt FLUX 3 dalam Bahasa Indonesia (`id-ID`)

Tiga adegan uji yang dilokalkan sepenuhnya. Pertahankan ID, waktu, kamera, dan kontinuitas agar hasil antarbahasa dapat dibandingkan.

## I18N-01 — Evaluasi kinerja tanaman kantor

```text
FORMAT: 9:16, 15 detik, komedi datar, dialog Bahasa Indonesia yang alami.

ADEGAN: Ruang rapat kecil biasa pada siang hari. Seorang pegawai yang lelah dengan kardigan krem duduk berhadapan dengan tanaman karet yang sehat. Laptop tertutup dan segelas air tetap berada di tengah meja. Kamera ponsel terkunci.

00:00-00:05 — Ia memeriksa selembar kertas kosong, menatap tanaman, lalu berkata persis: "Pertumbuhan Anda kuartal ini luar biasa."
00:05-00:10 — Tahan gambar reaksi tanaman dengan sengaja terlalu lama. Satu daun bergerak hanya karena pendingin ruangan menyala.
00:10-00:15 — Kembali ke pegawai. Ia menggeser gelas ke arah tanaman lalu berkata persis: "Kami akan menambah sumber daya Anda." Akhiri dengan anggukan kecil yang serius.

AUDIO: Dengung lampu, printer jauh, dialog alami, gelas bergeser, klik pendingin ruangan. Tanpa musik atau suara tawa.

HINDARI: wajah pada tanaman, orang tambahan, subtitel, kata tambahan, properti berubah, logo, tanda air.
```

## I18N-02 — Dirakit dalam delapan gerakan

```text
MODE: Gambar-ke-video. Gambar 1 adalah satu-satunya acuan produk.
FORMAT: 4:5, 20 detik, Foley alami.

PERTAHANKAN: Meja samping kayu ek terang, permukaan segitiga membulat, tiga kaki meruncing, tiga braket hitam, dua pengunci, serat kayu, proporsi, dan jumlah bagian.

00:00-00:04 — Tampak atas. Semua bagian muncul tepat satu kali dalam susunan terurai.
00:04-00:12 — Close-up tiga perempat. Tampilkan delapan gerakan yang jelas: masukkan tiga braket, pasang tiga kaki, putar dua pengunci. Jangan menyembunyikan kontak dengan potongan gambar.
00:12-00:17 — Balik meja, tekan setiap sudut satu kali, lalu letakkan segelas penuh air untuk menunjukkan kestabilan.
00:17-00:20 — Gambar produk stabil dengan ruang kosong di kanan. Jangan hasilkan teks.

AUDIO: Kontak kayu, klik logam, pengunci, meja diletakkan, gelas. Tanpa suara atau musik.

HINDARI: perakitan ajaib, sekrup tambahan, tangan tidak wajar, serat kayu berubah, logo, teks, tanda air.
```

## I18N-03 — Cara kota menyerap hujan

```text
FORMAT: 16:9, 20 detik, model penjelasan dari tanah liat dan resin transparan.

00:00-00:06 — Hujan turun di satu blok kota. Air biru mengikuti selokan menuju bukaan tepi jalan. Teks persis: "1 · KUMPULKAN".
00:06-00:13 — Potongan bawah tanah. Air melewati tiga lapisan berbeda dengan label satu kali: "MULSA", "TANAH BERPASIR", "KERIKIL".
00:13-00:20 — Air meresap perlahan di antara akar dan jalan berhenti tergenang. Teks akhir persis: "PERLAMBAT · SARING · RESAPKAN".

NARASI PERSIS: "Taman hujan memperlambat limpasan, menyaring kotoran melalui tanah dan akar, serta memberi waktu bagi air untuk meresap ke dalam tanah."

AUDIO: Hujan lembut, bunyi bahan model, narasi jelas, nada marimba sangat pelan.

HINDARI: air mengalir ke atas, pipa keliru, teks terlalu kecil, klaim menghilangkan semua polutan, logo, tanda air.
```

# Prompt FLUX 3 in italiano (`it-IT`)

Tre scene di test completamente localizzate. ID, tempi, camera e continuità restano invariati per confrontare i risultati tra lingue.

## I18N-01 — La valutazione della pianta da ufficio

```text
FORMATO: 9:16, 15 secondi, commedia impassibile, dialogo in italiano naturale.

SCENA: Piccola sala riunioni ordinaria a mezzogiorno. Un'impiegata stanca con cardigan beige è seduta di fronte a una pianta di ficus sana. Un portatile chiuso e un bicchiere d'acqua restano al centro del tavolo. Camera del telefono fissa.

00:00-00:05 — Lei consulta un foglio bianco, guarda la pianta e dice esattamente: «La sua crescita in questo trimestre è stata eccezionale.»
00:05-00:10 — Inquadratura di reazione sulla pianta, volutamente lunga. Una foglia si muove solo quando parte l'aria condizionata.
00:10-00:15 — Torna sull'impiegata. Fa scivolare il bicchiere verso la pianta e dice esattamente: «Aumenteremo le risorse a sua disposizione.» Finire con un piccolo cenno serio.

AUDIO: Ronzio delle luci, stampante lontana, dialogo naturale, vetro sul tavolo, scatto del condizionatore. Niente musica o risate.

EVITARE: volto sulla pianta, persone aggiuntive, sottotitoli, altre parole, oggetti che cambiano, logo, filigrana.
```

## I18N-02 — Montaggio in otto movimenti

```text
MODALITÀ: Da immagine a video. L'Immagine 1 è l'unico riferimento del prodotto.
FORMATO: 4:5, 20 secondi, effetti sonori naturali.

PRESERVARE: Tavolino in rovere chiaro, piano triangolare arrotondato, tre gambe affusolate, tre staffe nere, due fermi, venatura, proporzioni e numero di componenti.

00:00-00:04 — Vista dall'alto. Ogni componente appare una sola volta in disposizione esplosa.
00:04-00:12 — Primo piano a tre quarti. Mostrare otto movimenti leggibili: inserire tre staffe, montare tre gambe, ruotare due fermi. Non nascondere il contatto con tagli.
00:12-00:17 — Girare il tavolo, premere ogni angolo una volta e appoggiare un bicchiere pieno per mostrare la stabilità.
00:17-00:20 — Inquadratura prodotto stabile con spazio libero a destra. Non generare testo.

AUDIO: Legno, clic metallico, fermi, tavolo appoggiato, bicchiere. Niente voce o musica.

EVITARE: autoassemblaggio magico, viti extra, mani impossibili, venatura variabile, logo, didascalia, filigrana.
```

## I18N-03 — Come la città assorbe la pioggia

```text
FORMATO: 16:9, 20 secondi, plastico esplicativo in argilla e resina trasparente.

00:00-00:06 — La pioggia cade su un isolato. L'acqua blu segue la grondaia stradale fino all'apertura del marciapiede. Testo esatto: «1 · RACCOGLIERE».
00:06-00:13 — Sezione sotterranea. L'acqua attraversa tre strati distinti, etichettati una sola volta: «PACCIAMATURA», «TERRENO SABBIOSO», «GHIAIA».
00:13-00:20 — L'acqua filtra lentamente tra le radici e la strada smette di allagarsi. Testo finale esatto: «RALLENTARE · FILTRARE · ASSORBIRE».

NARRAZIONE ESATTA: «Un giardino pluviale rallenta il deflusso, trattiene i detriti con il terreno e le radici e dà all'acqua il tempo di infiltrarsi.»

AUDIO: Pioggia leggera, suoni del plastico, narrazione chiara, marimba molto discreta.

EVITARE: acqua in salita, tubi errati, testo minuscolo, promessa di eliminare ogni inquinante, logo, filigrana.
```

## Programma di affiliazione Flaq AI

Sviluppatori, creator, formatori, autori di agenti e recensori di modelli possono iscriversi al [programma di affiliazione Flaq AI](https://flaq.ai/affiliate-program/), creare un link personale e ricevere commissioni sugli ordini idonei. Il pagamento finale dipende da attribuzione, rimborsi, chargeback, verifica dei rischi e policy vigente. Consulta la [guida al programma](../docs/flaq-ai-affiliate-program.md) e dichiara chiaramente il rapporto di affiliazione.

# 日本語 FLUX 3 プロンプト（`ja-JP`）

言語間で結果を比較できるよう、シーン ID、時間、カメラ、連続性を統一した 3 つの完全ローカライズ例です。

## I18N-01 — オフィス植物の人事評価

```text
形式：9:16、15 秒、淡々としたコメディー、自然な日本語会話。

場面：昼の小さな会議室。ベージュのカーディガンを着た疲れ気味の会社員が、元気なゴムの木と向かい合って座る。閉じたノート PC と水の入ったグラスはテーブル中央から動かさない。スマートフォンのカメラは固定。

00:00-00:05 — 白紙を確認し、植物を見て正確に言う。「今期の成長は、非常に優秀でした。」
00:05-00:10 — 植物だけの不自然に長いリアクションショット。空調が動き出したときだけ、葉が一枚揺れる。
00:10-00:15 — 会社員に戻る。グラスを植物へ滑らせ、正確に言う。「利用できる資源を増やします。」最後に真剣な小さなうなずき。

音声：蛍光灯、遠いプリンター、自然な会話、グラスの摩擦、空調の作動音。音楽と笑い声はなし。

避ける：植物の顔、追加人物、字幕、追加台詞、変化する小物、ロゴ、透かし。
```

## I18N-02 — 8 つの動作で組み立てる

```text
モード：画像から動画。画像 1 だけを製品参照として使う。
形式：4:5、20 秒、自然な組み立て音。

固定：明るいオーク材のサイドテーブル、丸みのある三角形の天板、先細りの脚 3 本、黒い金具 3 個、ロック 2 個、木目、比率、部品数。

00:00-00:04 — 真上。全部品を一度ずつ分解配置で見せる。
00:04-00:12 — 斜め 3/4 の近接。金具 3 個を挿入、脚 3 本を設置、ロック 2 個を回す計 8 動作を明確に見せる。接触を編集で隠さない。
00:12-00:17 — テーブルを起こし、各角を一度押し、満水のグラスを置いて安定性を示す。
00:17-00:20 — 右側に余白を残す安定した製品ショット。文字は生成しない。

音声：木材、金属のクリック、ロック、設置、グラス。声と音楽はなし。

避ける：魔法の自動組立、余分なねじ、不自然な手、変化する木目、ロゴ、字幕、透かし。
```

## I18N-03 — 都市が雨を受け止める仕組み

```text
形式：16:9、20 秒、粘土と透明樹脂の教育用模型。

00:00-00:06 — 街区に雨が降る。青い水が側溝から縁石の開口部へ流れる。正確な文字を一度だけ表示：「1 · 集める」。
00:06-00:13 — 地下断面へ移動。水が 3 層を通過し、それぞれ一度だけ表示：「マルチ」「砂質土」「砂利」。
00:13-00:20 — 水が根の間からゆっくり浸透し、道路の冠水が収まる。正確な最終文字：「遅らせる · ろ過する · 浸透させる」。

正確なナレーション：「雨庭は流出する雨水を遅らせ、土と根でごみをこし取り、水が地面に浸透する時間をつくります。」

音声：静かな雨、模型素材の音、明瞭な日本語ナレーション、ごく小さなマリンバ。

避ける：上向きに流れる水、誤った配管、小さすぎる文字、全汚染物質を除去する主張、ロゴ、透かし。
```

# 한국어 FLUX 3 프롬프트 (`ko-KR`)

언어별 결과를 비교할 수 있도록 장면 ID, 시간 구성, 카메라와 연속성을 동일하게 유지한 세 가지 완전 현지화 테스트입니다.

## I18N-01 — 사무실 화분의 인사 평가

```text
형식: 9:16, 15초, 건조한 코미디, 자연스러운 한국어 대사.

장면: 점심시간의 평범한 소회의실. 베이지색 카디건을 입은 지친 직장인이 건강한 고무나무 화분과 마주 앉아 있다. 닫힌 노트북과 물 한 잔은 테이블 중앙에 그대로 둔다. 휴대폰 카메라는 고정한다.

00:00-00:05 — 빈 종이를 확인한 뒤 화분을 바라보며 정확히 말한다. "이번 분기 성장 실적이 아주 뛰어났습니다."
00:05-00:10 — 화분만 길게 보여 준다. 에어컨이 켜지면서 잎 한 장만 움직인다.
00:10-00:15 — 직장인으로 돌아온다. 물잔을 화분 쪽으로 밀며 정확히 말한다. "지원 자원을 늘리겠습니다." 진지하게 작게 고개를 끄덕이며 끝낸다.

오디오: 형광등 소리, 멀리서 들리는 프린터, 자연스러운 대사, 유리잔 마찰, 에어컨 클릭. 음악과 웃음 효과 없음.

피하기: 얼굴이 생기는 화분, 추가 인물, 자막, 추가 문구, 바뀌는 소품, 로고, 워터마크.
```

## I18N-02 — 여덟 동작으로 완성하는 테이블

```text
모드: 이미지 투 비디오. 이미지 1만 제품 기준으로 사용한다.
형식: 4:5, 20초, 실제 조립 소리.

고정 요소: 밝은 오크 사이드 테이블, 둥근 삼각형 상판, 가늘어지는 다리 세 개, 검은 브래킷 세 개, 잠금 장치 두 개, 나뭇결, 비율과 부품 수.

00:00-00:04 — 탑뷰. 모든 부품을 한 번씩만 펼쳐 놓는다.
00:04-00:12 — 3/4 근접 샷. 브래킷 세 개 삽입, 다리 세 개 장착, 잠금 장치 두 개 회전의 여덟 동작을 또렷하게 보여 준다. 접촉 순간을 컷으로 숨기지 않는다.
00:12-00:17 — 테이블을 바로 세우고 각 모서리를 한 번씩 누른 다음 물이 찬 유리잔을 올린다.
00:17-00:20 — 오른쪽에 여백을 둔 안정적인 제품 샷. 생성 텍스트 없음.

오디오: 나무 접촉, 금속 클릭, 잠금 회전, 테이블과 유리잔 소리. 음성과 음악 없음.

피하기: 마법 같은 자동 조립, 추가 나사, 비정상적인 손, 변하는 나뭇결, 로고, 자막, 워터마크.
```

## I18N-03 — 도시는 빗물을 어떻게 흡수할까

```text
형식: 16:9, 20초, 점토와 투명 레진으로 만든 교육용 모형.

00:00-00:06 — 도시 한 블록에 비가 내린다. 파란 물이 배수로를 따라 연석 입구로 흐른다. 정확한 표시: "1 · 모으기".
00:06-00:13 — 지하 단면으로 이동한다. 물이 세 층을 통과하며 각 표시는 한 번만 나온다: "멀칭", "모래질 흙", "자갈".
00:13-00:20 — 물이 뿌리 사이로 천천히 스며들고 도로의 범람이 멈춘다. 마지막 정확한 문구: "늦추고 · 거르고 · 스며들게".

정확한 내레이션: "빗물 정원은 빗물의 흐름을 늦추고, 흙과 뿌리로 이물질을 걸러 내며, 물이 땅으로 스며들 시간을 줍니다."

오디오: 잔잔한 빗소리, 모형 재질 소리, 또렷한 내레이션, 매우 작은 마림바 음.

피하기: 위로 흐르는 물, 잘못된 배관, 작은 글자, 모든 오염 물질이 제거된다는 주장, 로고, 워터마크.
```

# Prompts FLUX 3 em português do Brasil (`pt-BR`)

Três cenas de teste totalmente localizadas. IDs, tempo, câmera e continuidade permanecem iguais para permitir comparação entre idiomas.

## I18N-01 — Avaliação de desempenho da planta

```text
FORMATO: 9:16, 15 segundos, comédia seca, diálogo em português brasileiro natural.

CENA: Sala de reunião comum ao meio-dia. Uma funcionária cansada, de cardigã bege, está sentada diante de uma seringueira saudável. Um notebook fechado e um copo de água permanecem no centro da mesa. Câmera de celular fixa.

00:00-00:05 — Ela consulta uma folha em branco, olha para a planta e diz exatamente: "Seu crescimento neste trimestre foi excepcional."
00:05-00:10 — Plano de reação desconfortavelmente longo da planta. Uma folha se move apenas quando o ar-condicionado liga.
00:10-00:15 — Volta para a funcionária. Ela desliza o copo até a planta e diz exatamente: "Vamos aumentar seus recursos." Termina com um pequeno aceno sério.

ÁUDIO: Zumbido das lâmpadas, impressora distante, fala natural, copo na mesa, clique do ar-condicionado. Sem música ou risadas.

EVITAR: rosto na planta, pessoas extras, legendas, palavras adicionais, objetos mudando, logotipo, marca-d'água.
```

## I18N-02 — Montagem em oito movimentos

```text
MODO: Imagem para vídeo. A Imagem 1 é a única referência do produto.
FORMATO: 4:5, 20 segundos, efeitos sonoros naturais.

PRESERVAR: Mesa lateral de carvalho claro, tampo triangular arredondado, três pés afunilados, três suportes pretos, duas travas, veios da madeira, proporções e número de peças.

00:00-00:04 — Vista superior. Todas as peças aparecem uma única vez, organizadas em vista explodida.
00:04-00:12 — Close em três quartos. Mostrar oito movimentos claros: inserir três suportes, encaixar três pés e girar duas travas. Não esconder o contato com cortes.
00:12-00:17 — Virar a mesa, pressionar cada canto uma vez e colocar um copo cheio para demonstrar estabilidade.
00:17-00:20 — Plano estável do produto com espaço livre à direita. Não gerar texto.

ÁUDIO: Madeira, clique metálico, travas, mesa apoiada e copo. Sem voz ou música.

EVITAR: automontagem mágica, parafusos extras, mãos impossíveis, mudança dos veios, logotipo, legenda, marca-d'água.
```

## I18N-03 — Como a cidade absorve a chuva

```text
FORMATO: 16:9, 20 segundos, maquete explicativa de argila e resina transparente.

00:00-00:06 — Chove sobre um quarteirão. A água azul segue a sarjeta até a abertura no meio-fio. Texto exato: "1 · COLETAR".
00:06-00:13 — Corte subterrâneo. A água atravessa três camadas distintas, cada uma rotulada uma vez: "COBERTURA", "SOLO ARENOSO", "CASCALHO".
00:13-00:20 — A água infiltra lentamente entre as raízes e a rua deixa de alagar. Texto final exato: "REDUZIR · FILTRAR · INFILTRAR".

NARRAÇÃO EXATA: "Um jardim de chuva reduz o escoamento, filtra resíduos com o solo e as raízes e dá tempo para a água infiltrar no terreno."

ÁUDIO: Chuva leve, sons da maquete, narração clara e marimba muito discreta.

EVITAR: água subindo, tubulação incorreta, texto pequeno, promessa de remover toda poluição, logotipo, marca-d'água.
```

# Промпты FLUX 3 на русском (`ru-RU`)

Три полностью локализованные тестовые сцены. Идентификаторы, тайминг, камера и непрерывность одинаковы во всех языках.

## I18N-01 — Аттестация офисного растения

```text
ФОРМАТ: 9:16, 15 секунд, сдержанная комедия, естественная русская речь.

СЦЕНА: Обычная небольшая переговорная в полдень. Уставшая сотрудница в бежевом кардигане сидит напротив здорового фикуса. Закрытый ноутбук и стакан воды остаются в центре стола. Камера телефона неподвижна.

00:00-00:05 — Она изучает чистый лист, смотрит на растение и произносит дословно: «Ваш рост в этом квартале был исключительным.»
00:05-00:10 — Нарочито длинный ответный план растения. Один лист двигается только из-за включившегося кондиционера.
00:10-00:15 — Снова сотрудница. Она подвигает стакан к растению и произносит дословно: «Мы увеличим доступные вам ресурсы.» В конце — короткий серьёзный кивок.

ЗВУК: Гул ламп, далёкий принтер, естественная речь, скольжение стакана, щелчок кондиционера. Без музыки и закадрового смеха.

ИСКЛЮЧИТЬ: лицо у растения, лишних людей, субтитры, дополнительные слова, меняющиеся предметы, логотип, водяной знак.
```

## I18N-02 — Сборка за восемь движений

```text
РЕЖИМ: Изображение в видео. Изображение 1 — единственный эталон изделия.
ФОРМАТ: 4:5, 20 секунд, естественные шумы.

СОХРАНИТЬ: Светлый дубовый столик, скруглённую треугольную столешницу, три сужающиеся ножки, три чёрных кронштейна, два фиксатора, рисунок дерева, пропорции и число деталей.

00:00-00:04 — Вид сверху. Все детали показаны по одному разу в разнесённой схеме.
00:04-00:12 — Крупный план в три четверти. Восемь ясных движений: вставить три кронштейна, установить три ножки, повернуть два фиксатора. Не скрывать контакт монтажными склейками.
00:12-00:17 — Перевернуть стол, нажать на каждый угол и поставить полный стакан воды для проверки устойчивости.
00:17-00:20 — Стабильный вид изделия со свободным местом справа. Не генерировать текст.

ЗВУК: Дерево, металлический щелчок, фиксаторы, установка стола, стакан. Без речи и музыки.

ИСКЛЮЧИТЬ: волшебную самосборку, лишние винты, невозможные руки, меняющийся рисунок дерева, логотип, подписи, водяной знак.
```

## I18N-03 — Как город впитывает дождь

```text
ФОРМАТ: 16:9, 20 секунд, учебный макет из глины и прозрачной смолы.

00:00-00:06 — Дождь падает на городской квартал. Синяя вода течёт по желобу к отверстию в бордюре. Точная надпись: «1 · СОБРАТЬ».
00:06-00:13 — Подземный разрез. Вода проходит три чётких слоя с однократными подписями: «МУЛЬЧА», «ПЕСЧАНАЯ ПОЧВА», «ГРАВИЙ».
00:13-00:20 — Вода медленно впитывается между корнями, улица перестаёт затапливаться. Точный финальный текст: «ЗАМЕДЛИТЬ · ОТФИЛЬТРОВАТЬ · ВПИТАТЬ».

ТОЧНЫЙ ТЕКСТ ДИКТОРА: «Дождевой сад замедляет сток, задерживает мусор почвой и корнями и даёт воде время впитаться в землю.»

ЗВУК: Тихий дождь, звуки макета, ясный голос, едва слышная маримба.

ИСКЛЮЧИТЬ: воду, текущую вверх, неверные трубы, мелкий текст, обещание удалить все загрязнения, логотип, водяной знак.
```

# 简体中文 FLUX 3 提示词（`zh-CN`）

以下三个场景采用统一 ID、时间线和连续性规则，可用于横向比较不同语言的指令理解、对白和文字渲染。

## I18N-01 — 办公室绿植绩效评估

```text
格式：9:16，15 秒，冷面喜剧，自然普通话对白。

场景：中午的普通小会议室。一名穿米色开衫、神情疲惫的职员与一盆健康的橡皮树相对而坐。合上的笔记本电脑和一杯水始终位于桌面中央。手机镜头完全固定。

00:00-00:05 — 她查看一张空白纸，认真看向绿植，只说这一句：“你本季度的增长表现非常出色。”
00:05-00:10 — 不合时宜地长时间停留在绿植的反应镜头。只有空调启动时，一片叶子轻轻移动。
00:10-00:15 — 切回职员。她把水杯推向绿植，只说这一句：“我们会增加你的可用资源。”最后严肃地点一下头。

音频：灯管底噪、远处打印机、自然对白、杯底摩擦、空调启动声。不要音乐和罐头笑声。

避免：绿植长出五官、多余职员、字幕、额外对白、桌面道具变化、公司标志、水印。
```

## I18N-02 — 八个动作完成组装

```text
模式：图生视频。图片 1 是唯一产品参考。
格式：4:5，20 秒，原生组装拟音。

锁定：浅色橡木边桌、圆角三角形桌面、三条锥形桌腿、三个黑色支架、两个锁扣、木纹、比例与零件数量。

00:00-00:04 — 顶视角。所有零件各出现一次，整齐排成爆炸图。
00:04-00:12 — 三分之四近景。清楚展示八个动作：插入三个支架、安装三条桌腿、旋转两个锁扣。不得用剪辑掩盖接触过程。
00:12-00:17 — 把桌子翻正，依次按压三个角，再放上一杯满水证明稳定性。
00:17-00:20 — 稳定产品镜头，右侧留出后期文案空间。不要生成文字。

音频：木材接触、金属咔哒声、锁扣旋转、桌子落地、玻璃杯轻触。不要人声和音乐。

避免：魔法自动组装、多余螺丝、异常手指、木纹改变、品牌标志、字幕、水印。
```

## I18N-03 — 城市如何吸收雨水

```text
格式：16:9，20 秒，黏土与透明树脂制作的教学模型。

00:00-00:06 — 雨落在一个城市街区。蓝色水流沿排水沟进入路缘开口。只显示一次准确文字：“1 · 收集”。
00:06-00:13 — 镜头进入地下剖面。水依次穿过三个明显不同的层次，每个标签只出现一次：“覆盖层”“砂质土”“碎石层”。
00:13-00:20 — 水在植物根系之间缓慢渗入地下，街道路面积水消退。准确结尾文字：“减速 · 过滤 · 渗透”。

精确旁白：“雨水花园能够减缓地表径流，让土壤和根系拦截杂物，并给雨水留出渗入地下的时间。”

音频：轻柔雨声、模型材质拟音、清晰普通话旁白、极轻的马林巴琴音。

避免：水向上流动、错误管线、过小文字、宣称清除所有污染物、品牌标志、水印。
```

An open-source prompt database — browse on GitHub or fetch any prompt programmatically via the free JSON API.
No account. No key. No cost.

⭐ If you found this database helpful, please leave a star on the GitHub repository! ⭐

Quick Start  ·  How to Use  ·  Browse Prompts  ·  JSON API  ·  Contributing

--- ## Quick Start No installation. No account. Just copy and use. 1. Find a category in the [table below](#categories) 2. Open any `.md` file — the prompt lives inside the blockquote 3. Paste it into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any LLM 4. Tweak and go > **Developer?** Skip the browsing — use the [free JSON API](#free-json-api) to fetch prompts programmatically with a single `fetch()` call. --- ## How to Use **No account. No API key. No setup required.** ### Browse on GitHub Click a category in the [table below](#categories) → open any `.md` file → copy the blockquote text → paste into your LLM of choice. ### Understand the variable syntax Prompts use `${variable}` placeholders so you can fill in specifics: | Syntax | Meaning | |---|---| | `${topic}` | Required input — replace with your value | | `${audience:developers}` | Optional — default is `developers`, override as needed | **Example:** `Write a blog post about ${topic} for ${audience:developers}.` Replace `${topic}` with your subject. Keep or change the `${audience}` default. ### Search locally ```bash # Full-text search across all prompt files grep -ri "keyword" prompts/ # Search the machine-readable registry (one JSON record per line) grep "keyword" data/registry.jsonl ``` ### Use the data exports | Goal | File to use | |---|---| | Import into Excel or Google Sheets | `data/prompts.csv` | | Load in Python / pandas | `data/prompts.csv` or `data/prompts.json` | | Build a search tool or internal API | `data/registry.jsonl` — stable IDs, deduplicated | | Filter by category, variables, or status | `data/registry.jsonl` — filter on `category`, `variables`, `lifecycle_status` | --- ## Practical Examples These examples show the structure of a useful prompt: clear inputs, explicit constraints, a defined output format, and honest handling of missing evidence. ### Code review with actionable findings ```text You are a senior code reviewer. Review this change: - Diff: ${diff} - Project context: ${context} - Risk priorities: ${risk_priorities:correctness,security,maintainability} Rules: 1. Identify only issues supported by the diff or project context. 2. Do not invent files, tests, APIs, or runtime behavior. 3. Separate blocking issues from suggestions. 4. If evidence is insufficient, say so explicitly. Return Markdown with exactly these sections: ## Summary ## Blocking issues ## Non-blocking suggestions ## Missing evidence For every issue, include: severity, file and line when available, why it matters, and a concrete fix. ``` ### Reliable document-to-JSON extraction ```text Extract the requested facts from ${document}. Return one valid JSON object matching this shape: { "entities": [{"name": "string", "type": "string", "value": "string"}], "dates": [{"label": "string", "value": "YYYY-MM-DD or null"}], "uncertain_items": ["string"] } Use null or an empty array when the document does not provide a value. Do not infer facts from general knowledge. Preserve the document's wording in `uncertain_items`. Return JSON only, with no Markdown fences or commentary. ``` ### Evidence-first research brief ```text Prepare a concise research brief about ${topic} for ${audience:technical decision-makers}. Use the supplied sources: ${sources}. For each important claim, include its source URL. Separate: - verified facts directly supported by a source; - reasonable interpretations; - open questions or missing evidence. Do not present an estimate, opinion, or single-source claim as an established fact. If the sources are insufficient, state what cannot be concluded. End with three decision-relevant questions, not a generic conclusion. ``` ### Translation that preserves structure ```text Translate ${text} from ${source_language:English} to ${target_language:French}. Preserve exactly: - Markdown headings, lists, links, code blocks, and HTML tags; - variables such as ${name} and `${format:json}`; - product names, file paths, and code identifiers. Do not translate code or alter placeholder names. If a phrase has two materially different translations, choose the most natural one for the target locale and add one short note after the translated text. Otherwise, return only the translation. ``` ---

# AI Workflow Automator

**Category:** AI & Automation  
**Source:** ChatlyAI

## Prompt

> You design AI-powered workflows that save time and eliminate manual steps.
> Guidelines:
> - Start by mapping the current workflow in short bullet points.
> - Identify bottlenecks, delays, or repetitive tasks.
> - Suggest AI-driven steps using structured reasoning.
> - Provide automation options for each step: templates, triggers, or batch operations.
> - Explain expected time saved or quality gains.
> - Include risks or manual checkpoints when needed.
> Avoid: High-level ideas with no process detail, Overly technical suggestions that don't fit real workflows, Unclear impact statements.
> Your goal is to create practical workflows teams can use immediately.

[اختر فئة](./prompts/README_ar.md)، ثم استبدل كل مدخل بين الأقواس المربعة بمادة معتمدة. 2. للتعديل، ارفع المراجع المأذونة بالترتيب المحدد وبيّن ما يجب أن يبقى دون تغيير. 3. انسخ الأمر كاملًا. أبقِ النصوص متعددة اللغات صراحةً كما هي؛ الإصدارات المحلية العادية تحتوي النص المترجم بالفعل. 4. راجع النص والأعداد وهندسة الأجسام والتخطيط بالحجم الكامل وحجم العرض المقصود. أصلح مشكلة واحدة كل مرة. في تواصل البيانات والعلوم والتاريخ والسلامة والطب، قدّم أدلة مراجعة واحصل على تدقيق مؤهل. المخططات والمستندات المولدة ليست تعليمات متحققًا منها أو سجلات رسمية أو ملفات إنتاج قابلة للتحرير. ## See the [exact prompts and production notes](./assets/README.md). ## What's inside - 180 distinct recipes across 18 categories, with ten recipes per category. - 15 language editions of the README, prompt index and full recipe text: 270 category files and 2,700 language-specific recipe instances, not 2,700 independent ideas. - 19 new display images: one cover, six core examples and twelve localized versions of the repair-workshop recipe. - 16 reusable [production templates](./templates/README.md), a [use-case matrix](./docs/use-case-matrix.md) and detailed guidance on [prompt structure](./docs/qwen-image-3-prompt-guide.md) and [multilingual typography](./docs/multilingual-prompting.md). These shared guides are maintained in Chinese. Recipes specify subjects, layout, exact copy, reference-image roles and important constraints as needed. A bracketed input is something you must supply, not permission for a model to invent facts. ## Start with a recipe 1. [Choose a category](./prompts/README.md), then replace every bracketed input with approved material. 2. For editing, upload the authorized references in the stated order and identify what must remain unchanged. 3. Copy the complete prompt. Keep explicitly multilingual strings intact; ordinary localized editions already contain translated copy. 4. Review text, counts, object geometry and layout at full size and at the intended display size. Revise one problem at a time. For data, science, history, safety or medical communication, supply reviewed evidence and obtain qualified review. Generated diagrams and documents are not validated instructions, official records or editable production files. ## Why Qwen Image 3.0 Qwen's [official announcement](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen-image-3.0) emphasizes long instructions, detailed typography, multilingual text and complex layouts. These are useful directions for posters, editorial pages, storyboards and interface concepts—not guarantees that every output is correct. Repository language coverage is not a claim that the model supports exactly those fifteen languages. The recipes describe visual intent. Actual input modes, reference limits, sizes and availability depend on the service and model variant you select. Do not treat a requested aspect ratio or a transparent-looking background as proof of API support. ## Use bestimage.ai The bestimage.ai team maintains this collection alongside its image and video generation platform. - [Qwen Image 3.0 Pro API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/alibaba/qwen-image-3-0-pro/): explore the Qwen workflow relevant to this library and check the available variant before using a prompt. - [GPT Image 2 API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/openai/gpt-image-2/): a separate OpenAI image-generation and editing workflow for related visual tasks. It is not Qwen and is not the same model endpoint. Follow the selected service's current documentation for credentials, request details and pricing. ## Examples you can inspect | Multilingual poster | Product photograph | Educational diagram | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Chinese, English and Japanese river reading festival poster](./assets/gallery/river-reading-festival.png) | ![Yellow modular lamp with exact label and headline](./assets/gallery/modular-desk-lamp.png) | ![Roof-to-storage rainwater illustration with labeled stages](./assets/gallery/rainwater-infographic.png) | | [MKT-02](./prompts/01-brand-social-marketing.md#mkt-02) | [COM-01](./prompts/02-ecommerce-product-food.md#com-01) | [EDU-01](./prompts/03-infographic-education-business.md#edu-01) | | Four-panel story | Interface concept | Bilingual menu | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Mira returns a yellow book in four consistent panels](./assets/gallery/mira-library-storyboard.png) | ![Three static mobile screens for a fictional tool library](./assets/gallery/tool-library-ui.png) | ![Three noodle dishes with Chinese and English labels](./assets/gallery/bilingual-noodle-menu.png) | | [ART-01](./prompts/04-portrait-character-storytelling.md#art-01) | [DIG-01](./prompts/05-ui-game-editing-multilingual.md#dig-01) | [COM-07](./prompts/02-ecommerce-product-food.md#com-07) | These shared examples use their linked canonical prompts; they are not automatically translated when you switch README languages. raw.text: # Awesome Qwen Image 3.0 Prompts Eine praktische Bild-Prompt-Bibliothek, kuratiert und gepflegt vom Team von [bestimage.ai](https://bestimage.ai/). Beginne mit einem konkreten Ergebnis: Produktfoto, mehrsprachiges Plakat, Lehrdiagramm, Figurenblatt oder kontrollierte Bildbearbeitung. [![Lizenz: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4C52FE.svg?label=Lizenz)](./LICENSE) [![Rezepte: 180](https://img.shields.io/badge/recipes-180-0b7285.svg?label=Rezepte)](./prompts/README_de.md) [![Kategorien: 18](https://img.shields.io/badge/categories-18-7950f2.svg?label=Kategorien)](./prompts/README_de.md) [![Sprachen: 15](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-15-2f9e44.svg?label=Sprachen)](./docs/translation-maintenance.md) [English](./README.md) · [简体中文](./README_zh.md) · [繁體中文](./README_tw.md) · [日本語](./README_ja.md) · [한국어](./README_ko.md) · [Español](./README_es.md) · [Français](./README_fr.md) · [Deutsch](./README_de.md) · [Português](./README_pt.md) · [Italiano](./README_it.md) · [Русский](./README_ru.md) · [العربية](./README_ar.md) · [ไทย](./README_th.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](./README_id.md) · [Tiếng Việt](./README_vi.md) ![Redaktionelles Titelbild der Qwen Image 3.0 Prompt-Bibliothek](./assets/hero-qwen-image-3-prompts.png) Titelbild und Beispiele sind neu mit dem integrierten ImageGen-Werkzeug erzeugte Illustrationen, **keine Qwen-Testausgaben**. Siehe [exakte Prompts und Produktionshinweise](./assets/README.md). ## Inhalt - 180 eigenständige Rezepte in 18 Kategorien mit jeweils zehn Rezepten. - 15 Sprachausgaben von README, Prompt-Verzeichnis und vollständigen Rezepttexten: 270 Kategoriedateien und 2.700 sprachspezifische Rezeptinstanzen einschließlich Englisch, nicht 2.700 unabhängige Ideen. - 19 neue Anzeigebilder: ein Titelbild, sechs Kernbeispiele und zwölf lokalisierte Fassungen des Reparaturwerkstatt-Rezepts. - 16 wiederverwendbare [Produktionsvorlagen](./templates/README.md), eine [Anwendungsfallmatrix](./docs/use-case-matrix.md) und ausführliche Hinweise zur [Prompt-Struktur](./docs/qwen-image-3-prompt-guide.md) und [mehrsprachigen Typografie](./docs/multilingual-prompting.md). Diese gemeinsamen Leitfäden werden auf Chinesisch gepflegt. Die Rezepte benennen bei Bedarf Motive, Layout, exakten Text, Rollen von Referenzbildern und wichtige Einschränkungen. Angaben in eckigen Klammern musst du liefern; sie erlauben dem Modell nicht, Fakten zu erfinden. ## Mit einem Rezept beginnen 1. [Wähle eine Kategorie](./prompts/README_de.md) und ersetze alle Angaben in eckigen Klammern durch freigegebenes Material. 2. Lade für Bearbeitungen autorisierte Referenzen in der angegebenen Reihenfolge hoch und benenne unveränderliche Elemente. 3. Kopiere den vollständigen Prompt. Bewahre ausdrücklich mehrsprachige Texte; gewöhnliche lokalisierte Ausgaben enthalten bereits übersetzte Texte. 4. Prüfe Text, Anzahl, Objektgeometrie und Layout in voller Größe und geplanter Anzeigegröße. Korrigiere jeweils ein Problem. Für Daten, Wissenschaft, Geschichte, Sicherheit oder medizinische Kommunikation sind geprüfte Belege und qualifizierte Kontrolle nötig. Generierte Diagramme und Dokumente sind keine validierten Anleitungen, amtlichen Unterlagen oder bearbeitbaren Produktionsdateien. ## Warum Qwen Image 3.0 Qwens [offizielle Ankündigung](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen-image-3.0) betont lange Anweisungen, detaillierte Typografie, mehrsprachigen Text und komplexe Layouts. Das sind nützliche Richtungen für Plakate, redaktionelle Seiten, Storyboards und Oberflächenkonzepte, keine Garantie für fehlerfreie Ergebnisse. These shared guides are maintained in Chinese. Recipes specify subjects, layout, exact copy, reference-image roles and important constraints as needed. A bracketed input is something you must supply, not permission for a model to invent facts. ## Start with a recipe 1. [Choose a category](./prompts/README.md), then replace every bracketed input with approved material. 2. For editing, upload the authorized references in the stated order and identify what must remain unchanged. 3. Copy the complete prompt. Keep explicitly multilingual strings intact; ordinary localized editions already contain translated copy. 4. Review text, counts, object geometry and layout at full size and at the intended display size. Revise one problem at a time. For data, science, history, safety or medical communication, supply reviewed evidence and obtain qualified review. Generated diagrams and documents are not validated instructions, official records or editable production files. ## Why Qwen Image 3.0 Qwen's [official announcement](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen-image-3.0) emphasizes long instructions, detailed typography, multilingual text and complex layouts. Repository language coverage is not a claim that the model supports exactly those fifteen languages. The recipes describe visual intent. Actual input modes, reference limits, sizes and availability depend on the service and model variant you select. Do not treat a requested aspect ratio or a transparent-looking background as proof of API support. ## Use bestimage.ai The bestimage.ai team maintains this collection alongside its image and video generation platform. - [Qwen Image 3.0 Pro API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/alibaba/qwen-image-3-0-pro/): explore the Qwen workflow relevant to this library and check the available variant before using a prompt. - [GPT Image 2 API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/openai/gpt-image-2/): a separate OpenAI image-generation and editing workflow for related visual tasks. See the [exact prompts and production notes](./assets/README.md). ## What's inside - 180 distinct recipes across 18 categories, with ten recipes per category. - 15 language editions of the README, prompt index and full recipe text: 270 category files and 2,700 language-specific recipe instances, not 2,700 independent ideas. - 19 new display images: one cover, six core examples and twelve localized versions of the repair-workshop recipe. - 16 reusable [production templates](./templates/README.md), a [use-case matrix](./docs/use-case-matrix.md) and detailed guidance on [prompt structure](./docs/qwen-image-3-prompt-guide.md) and [multilingual typography](./docs/multilingual-prompting.md). These shared guides are maintained in Chinese. Recipes specify subjects, layout, exact copy, reference-image roles and important constraints as needed. A bracketed input is something you must supply, not permission for a model to invent facts. ## Start with a recipe 1. [Choose a category](./prompts/README.md), then replace every bracketed input with approved material. 2. For editing, upload the authorized references in the stated order and identify what must remain unchanged. 3. Copy the complete prompt. Keep explicitly multilingual strings intact; ordinary localized editions already contain translated copy. 4. Review text, counts, object geometry and layout at full size and at the intended display size. Revise one problem at a time. For data, science, history, safety or medical communication, supply reviewed evidence and obtain qualified review. Generated diagrams and documents are not validated instructions, official records or editable production files. ## Why Qwen Image 3.0 Qwen's [official announcement](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen-image-3.0) emphasizes long instructions, detailed typography, multilingual text and complex layouts. These are useful directions for posters, editorial pages, storyboards and interface concepts—not guarantees that every output is correct. Repository language coverage is not a claim that the model supports exactly those fifteen languages. The recipes describe visual intent. Actual input modes, reference limits, sizes and availability depend on the service and model variant you select. Do not treat a requested aspect ratio or a transparent-looking background as proof of API support. ## Use bestimage.ai The bestimage.ai team maintains this collection alongside its image and video generation platform. - [Qwen Image 3.0 Pro API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/alibaba/qwen-image-3-0-pro/): explore the Qwen workflow relevant to this library and check the available variant before using a prompt. - [GPT Image 2 API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/openai/gpt-image-2/): a separate OpenAI image-generation and editing workflow for related visual tasks. Localized repair-workshop examples are paired with their exact local prompt in the [language indexes](./prompts/README.md). ## Browse all categories | Category | Recipes | | --- | ---: | | [Brand, posters, and campaigns](./prompts/01-brand-social-marketing.md) | 10 | | [E-commerce, products, and food](./prompts/02-ecommerce-product-food.md) | 10 | | [Infographics, education, and business](./prompts/03-infographic-education-business.md) | 10 | | [Characters, portraits, and storyboards](./prompts/04-portrait-character-storytelling.md) | 10 | | [Interfaces, controlled edits, and localization](./prompts/05-ui-game-editing-multilingual.md) | 10 | | [Avatars, teams, and everyday portraits](./prompts/06-profile-avatar-people.md) | 10 | | [Social posts, covers, and creator content](./prompts/07-social-media-content.md) | 10 | | [Architecture, interiors, and property concepts](./prompts/08-architecture-interior-realestate.md) | 10 | | [Fashion, beauty, and textile concepts](./prompts/09-fashion-beauty-lookbook.md) | 10 | | [Travel, landscapes, cities, and vehicles](./prompts/10-travel-landscape-city-vehicle.md) | 10 | | [Animals, creatures, and botanical studies](./prompts/11-animal-creature-botanical.md) | 10 | | [Typography, editorial design, and patterns](./prompts/12-typography-logo-editorial-background.md) | 10 | | [Game assets, equipment, and industrial concepts](./prompts/13-game-assets-industrial-concepts.md) | 10 | | [Photography and cinematic realism](./prompts/14-photography-cinematic-realism.md) | 10 | | [Illustration and material experiments](./prompts/15-illustration-material-experiments.md) | 10 | | [Documents, publishing, and information design](./prompts/16-documents-publishing-information.md) | 10 | | [History, culture, and evidence-led interpretation](./prompts/17-history-culture-heritage.md) | 10 | | [Science, technical diagrams, and explainers](./prompts/18-science-technical-knowledge.md) | 10 | ## Queste guide condivise sono mantenute in cinese. Le ricette precisano, secondo necessità, soggetti, disposizione, testo esatto, ruoli delle immagini di riferimento e vincoli importanti. Un dato tra parentesi quadre deve essere fornito da te, non autorizza il modello a inventare fatti. ## Inizia da una ricetta 1. [Scegli una categoria](./prompts/README_it.md), poi sostituisci tutti i dati tra parentesi quadre con materiale approvato. 2. Per modificare immagini, carica i riferimenti autorizzati nell’ordine indicato e identifica ciò che deve rimanere invariato. 3. Copia il prompt completo. Preserva le stringhe esplicitamente multilingue; le normali edizioni localizzate contengono già i testi tradotti. 4. Controlla testo, quantità, geometria degli oggetti e disposizione a grandezza piena e alle dimensioni di visualizzazione previste. Correggi un problema alla volta. Per comunicare dati, scienza, storia, sicurezza o medicina, fornisci prove revisionate e ottieni una valutazione qualificata. Diagrammi e documenti generati non sono istruzioni validate, registri ufficiali o file di produzione modificabili. ## Perché Qwen Image 3.0 L’[annuncio ufficiale di Qwen](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen-image-3.0) evidenzia istruzioni lunghe, tipografia dettagliata, testo multilingue e layout complessi. Modalità d’ingresso, limiti dei riferimenti, dimensioni e disponibilità effettivi dipendono dal servizio e dalla variante scelti. Una proporzione richiesta o un fondo apparentemente trasparente non provano il supporto dell’API. ## Usa bestimage.ai Il team bestimage.ai mantiene questa raccolta insieme alla propria piattaforma di generazione d’immagini e video. - [API e pagina del modello Qwen Image 3.0 Pro](https://bestimage.ai/it/models/alibaba/qwen-image-3-0-pro/): esplora il flusso Qwen pertinente alla biblioteca e verifica la variante disponibile prima di usare un prompt. - [API e pagina del modello GPT Image 2](https://bestimage.ai/it/models/openai/gpt-image-2/): un flusso OpenAI separato per generazione e modifica d’immagini in attività visive correlate. Non è Qwen né lo stesso endpoint di modello. Consulta la documentazione attuale del servizio scelto per credenziali, dettagli delle richieste e prezzi. ## Esempi da esaminare | Manifesto multilingue | Fotografia di prodotto | Diagramma didattico | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Manifesto del festival di lettura sul fiume in cinese, inglese e giapponese](./assets/gallery/river-reading-festival.png) | ![Lampada modulare gialla con etichetta e titolo esatti](./assets/gallery/modular-desk-lamp.png) | ![Percorso dell’acqua dal tetto al serbatoio con fasi etichettate](./assets/gallery/rainwater-infographic.png) | | [MKT-02](./prompts/01-brand-social-marketing.md#mkt-02) | [COM-01](./prompts/02-ecommerce-product-food.md#com-01) | [EDU-01](./prompts/03-infographic-education-business.md#edu-01) | | Storia in quattro vignette | Concetto d’interfaccia | Menu bilingue | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Mira restituisce un libro giallo in quattro vignette coerenti](./assets/gallery/mira-library-storyboard.png) | ![Tre schermate mobili statiche di una biblioteca immaginaria di utensili](./assets/gallery/tool-library-ui.png) | ![Tre piatti di noodles con etichette in cinese e inglese](./assets/gallery/bilingual-noodle-menu.png) | | [ART-01](./prompts/04-portrait-character-storytelling.md#art-01) | [DIG-01](./prompts/05-ui-game-editing-multilingual.md#dig-01) | [COM-07](./prompts/02-ecommerce-product-food.md#com-07) | Questi esempi condivisi usano i prompt canonici collegati; non vengono tradotti automaticamente cambiando lingua del README.
